verdict.rationale: Make documents an official Make MCP server. AI systems like Claude and ChatGPT connect to it as MCP clients and get scenario-run and account-management tools, including viewing and modifying scenarios, connections, webhooks and data stores. Make Skills also help assistants connect to the server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections, and documented connection setup details such as transport, auth flow and supported plans.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: AI systems like Claude and ChatGPT act as MCP clients of Make MCP server. The server provides them access to **scenario run** and **management** tools
Make MCP server allows AI systems, such as large language models (LLMs), to run scenarios and manage the contents of your Make account.
View and modify scenarios and their related entities (e.g., connections, webhooks, and data stores)
Turns your **active** and **on-demand** scenarios into callable tools for AI
official MCP server documented at https://developers.make.com/mcp-server
